title: Subproject 42 (Midnight Climax)
summary: One-page memo in which Sidney Gottlieb, who ran MKULTRA, explains that people who covertly gave drugs to unwitting subjects for a CIA safehouse run by narcotics agent George White would be paid in cash, without receipts. Subproject 42 funded White's San Francisco safehouse, the operation known as Midnight Climax.

tree.title: Accountability for certain expenditures under Subproject 42 of MKULTRA
tree.summary: Memorandum for the record of 17 August 1956 by Sidney Gottlieb, Chief, TSS/CD. Subproject 42 gave a man, redacted but annotated "George White", a safehouse (handwritten "San Fran") to covertly give drugs to unwitting subjects. His helpers get small cash sums without receipts; each operation is reported to the Chief, TSS/Chemical Division. Approved 20 August 1956 by Chief, DD/P/TSS.
